key_dates_timeline.event: Employment commenced at Empired Ltd
Capgemini acquired Empired Ltd
Formal transfer to Capgemini — all contract terms carried over
Salary increased to $173,316. PIP (Western Power) completed and passed.
Mathew experiencing lack of traction on continued engagement
CRITICAL — Formal email to Vi Tran raising engagement visibility concerns. Four-month redeployment lead time begins.
Security clearance project — documentation never arrived before Mathew's overseas leave. Client keen. Mathew withdrew through Vi Tran as correct channel. Brock Sperryn and client aware.
Anup Sawant announced as Iteration Manager on nbn account. Mathew asked in writing if Anup stepping into his role. No reply received.

CRITICAL — Anle called Mathew directly about security clearance in abrasive tone. Mathew declined. Mathew immediately reported this to Vi Tran. Mathew told Vi Tran: 'Mark my words — this action will have a negative impact on me and she will seek retribution.' Written record of this report to Vi Tran needs to be confirmed and located.
Ravi Kumar confirmed in writing Mathew being moved off project. Admitted deliberately withheld before Christmas to not ruin vacation.
Mathew contacted Vi Tran five times across five days seeking redeployment. Vi Tran responded once.
Teams messages with Jean Gazo (confirmed hiring Ryan Bulan as new EM that week) and Vinnie Nair (acknowledged SA remote delivery viable — confirmed Vi Tran referral). Both during consultation period.

Meeting invitation received — 1 day notice, no agenda, no reference to redundancy. Mathew was embedded in client tenancy all day. Saw invitation in evening. Emailed Anle at 10:22pm requesting recording and offering to reschedule to Friday. Both ignored. Mathew contacted four separate individuals before finding Justin Bradstreet as support person.

Consultation meeting — 11 minutes (scheduled 20). Justin present but microphone non-functional. Recording refused. SAPN never mentioned. No documents or agenda. Mathew stated he needed time for independent advice. Pre-written consultation letter issued same afternoon. Internal opportunities link emailed.
Mathew formally raised SAPN role in writing to Oli Lambel with three specific questions about suitability assessment. NEVER raised by Capgemini — Mathew found and pursued it himself.
Morning: Oli closed SAPN informally via Teams — timing excuse only. No written assessment. No formal offer. Evening: Dr Rose Reed certified Mathew unfit for work from 6 March to 5 April 2026.

Termination call from Oli Lambel approximately 9:30am — approximately 3-4 minutes. Mathew requested time for legal advice. Oli appeared confused. Termination letter and email both issued — both contain written admissions of redeployment failure. Certificate date 5 March — Capgemini says no record it was provided before 6 March.
Final payslip paid. AL reversal $5,010.46 deducted. ESOP final deduction $639.63 (contended unauthorised). Lump Sum D $43,136.37 — covers only notice and severance.
Formal Notice sent to hr.support.au@capgemini.com claiming $20,032.38 PAL and ESOP. 7-day clock commenced.
F2 filed at fairwork.gov.au. Fee $89.70 paid. Filed without lawyer per Jason's tactical advice.
Capgemini payroll responded to PAL and ESOP formal notice — claimed no PAL owing and provided ESOP exit process details. This response not yet fully reviewed — CRITICAL GAP.
Blaire O'Loughlin-Mills (MinterEllison) emailed FWC requesting extension to file F3 — extension not granted. Extension request shows rushed preparation.

F3 filed by MinterEllison signed by Harriet Eager. Single jurisdictional objection — genuine redundancy. Professional Employees Award 2020 ticked as applying — potentially opens additional consultation ground.
Conciliation — estimated May 2026

legal_framework.primary_claim: s.394 Unfair Dismissal — Fair Work Act 2009

award_coverage.significance: URGENT — If PEA 2020 applies it contains consultation obligations. 11-minute Teams call with pre-written letter may not satisfy Award requirements. This is an additional ground under s.389(1)(b) that needs analysis before conciliation.
award_coverage.action_required: Pull PEA 2020 consultation and redundancy clauses. Compare to what Capgemini actually did.

part_1_role_still_required.capgemini_argument: Role reorganised and removed from Australian project structure. Duties redistributed. Role no longer exists even if work continues.
part_1_role_still_required.mathew_counter: 8-page handover document covers identical daily weekly monthly quarterly tasks. Anle admitted in consultation she did not know if NBN work moved offshore. If Anup doing identical work the role was not eliminated — it was offshored.

part_2_consultation_obligation.previous_assessment: Does not apply — no Modern Award or Enterprise Agreement
part_2_consultation_obligation.updated_assessment: POTENTIALLY APPLIES — Capgemini ticked PEA 2020 in F3. If Award applies this ground reopens and 11-minute meeting may not satisfy Award consultation requirements.
part_2_consultation_obligation.action_required: URGENT — research PEA 2020 consultation clause before conciliation

security_clearance_episode.action_required: URGENT — find written Teams message or email to Vi Tran on or around 12 December 2025 reporting Anle's conduct. This is the single most important unconfirmed document in the file.

costs_threat.capgemini_f3_paragraph: 4.10 — Capgemini reserves its rights in relation to costs
costs_threat.assessment: Empty threat. Standard intimidation tactic. Costs in unfair dismissal require frivolous vexatious or unreasonable conduct. Two written admissions, four-month redeployment failure, 50-plus contacts, post-hoc skills claim — this case does not meet that threshold. Not even close.

professional_employees_award_admission.action_required: Pull PEA 2020 and read consultation and redundancy clauses before conciliation

unfair_dismissal_compensation.basis: Lower of half annual salary ($86,271) or statutory cap ($91,550 for 2025-26)

termination_pay_received.conclusion: Lump sum covers exactly 13 weeks — zero PAL included

pal.description: 20 days (152 hours) purchased annual leave deducted January 2025 to February 2026. Zero days credited or utilised. Double-charged via $5,010.46 AL clawback at termination.

the_3333_vulnerability.entry: PU PAL Payment 31/12/25 $3,333.06 on January 2026 payslip
the_3333_vulnerability.capgemini_will_argue: This proves they already paid out PAL
the_3333_vulnerability.counter_argument: Prior cycle reconciliation not Cycle 3. Double-charge proves it — if credit cleared debt there would be positive leave balance. Ongoing deductions continued Jan and Feb 2026. Document 8 proves Capgemini knew correct process — Jan 2024 prior cycle correctly refunded at $8,967.60.

pal.recovery_path: Small claims division Federal Circuit and Family Court

esop.description: After-tax share plan contributions across 3 financial years
